links.comparator_used: Same five LLMs without CMedRAGBot (no knowledge-graph retrieval)
links.outcome: Test accuracy on Chinese Clinical Medical Qualification and Residency Standardization Training exam question banks (2000-2023)
links.effect: Significant accuracy improvement for all five models, with increases of up to approximately 10%
links.quote: The results indicate that the integration of CMedRAGBot significantly improves the test accuracy of all models, with increases of up to approximately 10%.

links.comparator_used: CMedRAGBot without the intent recognition module (ablation)
links.outcome: Understanding of complex queries and answer accuracy
links.effect: Intent recognition module markedly improves understanding of complex queries and further boosts answer accuracy (no numbers given in the abstract)
links.quote: Furthermore, ablation experiments reveal that data augmentation enhances NER model's F1 score from 95.27% to 97.55%, while the inclusion of an intent recognition module markedly improves the model's ability to understand complex queries, thereby further boosting answer accuracy.

design_hint: retrieval grounding with knowledge graph added to existing LLMs
